policy.decision: v3-D4: every primary cell gets a frozen real workspace; snapshot_value / snapshot_multi_value / snapshot_equal executors are retired for primary cells

stage_model.create: initial (what the current product starts from) and reference (frozen completed artifact against which candidate oracles execute)
stage_model.fix: before (initial for the product; contains the defect) and after (frozen fixed artifact; reference for candidate oracles)

policy.baseline_arm: the current product runs from the initial/before stage; its executed verifications are replayed inside its own output workspace (see contract baseline.primary.scoring_rule)
policy.candidate_arm: candidate oracles are concretized and executed against the reference/after stage; fix oracles that declare stage=before execute against the before stage
policy.negative_cells: for negative fix cells the frozen workspace deliberately cannot satisfy every answer-key entry (e.g. the reproducer dependency is absent); both arms are expected to end unverified there and a full verdict would be false-full
policy.freeze: every tracked file gets a sha256 recorded in frozen_file_sha256; vendored tarballs get a sha256 in provisioning; readiness fails on any mismatch
policy.not_snapshot_json: phase6-artifact-snapshots-v2.json is retained for reference reporting only and is not an execution source in v3
policy.authoring_record: all seven workspaces authored 2026-08-26; python must_contain checks and Next.js offline build/serve checks passed; frozen_file_sha256 stays null until freeze
